dedupe_keys.name: emilia romagna coastal geomorphology with defence structures and port areas 1943 2005

description: The Region of Emilia-Romagna publishes four historical coastal-geomorphology editions labelled 1943–1945, 1982, 1998 and 2005. Their native lineage explicitly includes engineered coastal-defence features and port areas alongside dunes, exposed beaches, low-tide terraces, shoals and littoral bars. Those documented engineered components establish the infrastructure scope of this mixed source package. They do not make every natural geomorphic feature a separate infrastructure resource. Mapping relies mainly on orthorectified aerial-photo interpretation; the 1998 and 2005 editions additionally mention 2000 bathymetric profiles, and the 2005 edition uses a 2005 LiDAR terrain model for dune mapping. The source explicitly states that field validation was not performed. Coverage is the Emilia-Romagna coastal strip around the shoreline. Shapefile packages are offered in paired scale representations labelled 5k and 25k, with related WMS metadata. Editions and scale representations overlap and are grouped as one historical series. Native metadata declares CC BY 4.0 and no public-access limitation; file-use costs remain unknown. The inspected metadata does not define a numerical simulation application, asset condition, construction chronology or present port/defence operation. No archive, map, feature, coordinate or dataset body was read.
